diffs.diff: chip ID register 0x0: part 16, datasheet reading 528
diffs.evidence: ENS210 datasheet, 'Register PART_ID (Address 0x00)': 'This 2 byte register identifies the part number in little endian (ENS210)' ... 'Bits 15:0 PART_ID Default 0x0210 Identifies this device as an ENS210'. 0x0210 = 528 is the 16-bit value; stored little endian, byte 0x00 = 0x10 = 16 and byte 0x01 = 0x02. The part's sim register map is byte-wise and sets 0x00=16 and 0x01=2, i.e. exactly 0x0210; the driver reads 2 bytes from 0x00 and returns b[0] | (b[1] << 8) = 0x0210. The second reading quotes the whole 16-bit value; both agree.
